Added and committed two regression tests covering the declaration load failures:

- A child declaration with an explicit ultimate payer loads without incorrectly requiring a selected parent payer.
- A company number stays paired with the `Company` donor kind when funder observations are grouped.

Both tests pass. Each also failed when I temporarily restored its original bug, confirming they catch the regressions. Formatting passed, and I updated [PR #26](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/26) with the test results.

The changes are committed on `fix/declaration-loader-parent-basis-20261008` as `c3640b0`. The local `todo.md` remains uncommitted. This follows the root-cause and behavior-focused testing principles: the tests exercise the loader’s observable results and demonstrate that each original failure is detected.

explain why hsbc is not deduplicated here:

GitHub Issues evidence only. No edits.

Queries in `johnnylarner/exposed` were `HSBC`, `deduplication`, `dedup`, `deduplicate`, `funder`, `identity resolution`, `resolution`, `Splink`, `alias`, and `entity`. I also searched `repo:johnnylarner/exposed is:issue`.

No results for HSBC, deduplication, dedup, deduplicate, identity resolution, Splink, or alias. The broad issue listing returned only issues #16 and #12. I fetched both descriptions and all comments. Both have zero comments.

[#16, Capture Parliament declarations and funding source fields in Parquet for offline processing](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/16). Author `johnnylarner`. Created `2026-10-03T13:07:41Z`. Closed completed `2026-10-04T16:37:44Z`. Label `ready-for-agent`. No milestone.

Relevant exact text:

> As a maintainer, I want names preserved as supplied, so that normalization can be revised during cleaning.

> Preserve source names and status strings exactly; perform normalization and enum interpretation later.

> Selecting the relevant version, choosing the attributed funder name, name normalization, parent-payer inheritance, funder identity resolution, and constructing final funding entries belong to later processing.

> The current declaration Fetch operation preserves the inputs to those decisions; it does not implement the cleaning or database-publication stages.

[#12, Implement Rust member capture to Parquet and atomic PostgreSQL loading](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/issues/12). Author `johnnylarner`. Created `2026-10-01T18:59:47Z`. Closed completed `2026-10-04T16:37:53Z`. Label `ready-for-agent`. No milestone.

Relevant exact text:

> This first increment covers members and their Commons service only. Declaration ingestion and the wider cleaning and resolution pipeline are deferred.

Gap. GitHub Issues contains no HSBC-specific example, merge decision, confidence threshold, alias policy, or ticket explaining why those three loaded funders remain separate. Issue #16 records stage responsibility and preservation of original names. It cannot establish the current runtime cause.
